title: erodium cicutarium subsp. praetermissum
intro: Erodium cicutarium subsp. praetermissum, commonly known as red-stemmed geranium or redstem storksbill, is a plant species within the geranium family (Geraniaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Erodium cicutarium subsp. praetermissum include wound healing, pain relief, and antiseptic activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been shown to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, contributing to its therapeutic potential.
